Associate Vice President, Institutional Effectiveness • Babcock University
Organized by the Institute for Faith Integration in the Office of Institutional
Effectiveness at Babcock University, the conference brings together thinkers and
practitioners committed to nurturing mind, character, and Christian service.
Fulfilling Isaiah 58:12, we welcome global participants to build sustainable,
Christ-centered ecosystems across modern professions and society.
building servant-leaders for a better world.

Explore published presentations and studies from earlier ICFI & FIPP gatherings.
How do I arrange campus accommodation?
On-campus accommodation (Babcock Guest House, Havillah Cottage, Royal Cream Suite) is available
for an additional fee. Contact Dr. Nnenna Nwobi at +234 813 538 8049 to arrange your stay.
How does the ₦10,000 community member discount work?
Registered ICFI community members receive ₦10,000 off the ₦50,000 conference fee and retain
Early Bird rates (₦40,000) even after the April 23, 2027 cutoff.
Can international or remote scholars participate online?
Yes. Virtual delegates can present papers live, join discussions, and qualify for free IJFI review.
